business_problem: scale partner analytics and payment-fraud detection without letting ingestion cost, manual analysis, or data fragmentation slow the business down.
solution_summary: Fresha uses Snowflake and Snowpipe on Snowflake to scale partner analytics and payment-fraud detection without letting ingestion cost, manual analysis, or data fragmentation slow the business down. Production databases, marketing systems, finance platforms, and transaction streams are centralized in Snowflake to serve both internal teams and partner-facing dashboards. Fresha refreshes transaction data frequently, applies machine-learning fraud checks, and uses Snowpipe to make ingestion more efficient than its earlier PostgreSQL-to-Snowflake pattern. Sales, marketing, and account teams use the internal analytics, while partners receive fresher operational insights through Fresha Insights and risk teams get near-real-time fraud signals. Keeping ingestion, storage, transformation, and governed access on one platform reduces handoffs, improves concurrency, and makes it easier to reuse trusted data across teams and applications.
